t: 李渊成为唐高祖，开启了唐朝对中国长达三个世纪的统治。
te: Li Yuan becomes Emperor Gaozu of Tang, initiating three centuries of Tang dynasty rule over China.
dz: 李渊成为唐高祖，开启了唐朝对中国长达三个世纪的统治。
de: Li Yuan becomes Emperor Gaozu of Tang, initiating three centuries of Tang dynasty rule over China.

t: 王世忠在燕石之战中果断地击败了李米.
te: Wang Shichong decisively defeats Li Mi at the Battle of Yanshi.
dz: 从苏地到唐地的过渡:王世忠在燕石之战中果断地击败了李米.
de: Transition from Sui to Tang: Wang Shichong decisively defeats Li Mi at the Battle of Yanshi.

t: 唐朝在"Q水会战"中,对对手薛连高取得了决定性的胜利.
te: The Tang dynasty scores a decisive victory over their rival Xue Rengao at the Battle of Qianshuiyuan.
dz: 唐朝在"Q水会战"中,对对手薛连高取得了决定性的胜利.
de: The Tang dynasty scores a decisive victory over their rival Xue Rengao at the Battle of Qianshuiyuan.
